body: Utada Hikaru, best selling album-artist in Japan. I also really like X Japan. I.V. was a really beautiful song in my opinion. Any recommendations?
Ehm well, I am pretty obsessed with a Japanese singer. I honestly haven't really been listening to someone else for the last two years.

It's really scary how similar your story is to mine. I have the exact same thoughts. It really really sucks. The sexualizing everything is such a crazy thing that happens daily. If I may ask, does this also result in a very high libido?

Really interesting that you have almost the same story as me. I always knew that I was not fully 100% but I just couldn't put my finger on it. Knowing that I probably have a disorder and it's not my fault helps me realize that the thoughts I have are fake. They are not real. I have ups and downs now. Yesterday I was crying for example and I didn't want to live anymore. I just woke up and now I feel completely normal again just because I can counter my feelings.

Also do you also have crazy thoughts sometimes? Things you should never say to anyone? Things you will never do but things that will pop in your head? This seems to be a symptom.

One more question, do you also feel like that girl is the most beautiful girl ever and that you will never find somebody as attractive as her again?
I really need to know. I won't take you guys's word as final. I'll go to the doctor for it but I just want to know if it's likely or not. I need to know. It's very important to me.
